crossRefs.note: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples…
Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

parallels.note: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
translations.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
translations.asv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that thou to-day, even this night, before the cock crow twice, shalt deny me thrice.
